pair.title: Connect to Camera Station
pair.subtitle: Log in to your AXIS Camera Station Pro server. These are the same details you use for the Camera Station web client.
pair.hostHint: The IP address or name of the computer running Camera Station Pro. Example: 192.168.1.250
pair.usernameHint: A Camera Station user that may view live video. Example: axis
pair.missingFields: Fill in the server address, username and password.

errors.notConfigured: Not connected to Camera Station yet. Open the camera in Homey, tap the cog (⚙) in the top right, then tap Repair and log in.
errors.liveFailed: Could not start live video from Camera Station. Check that the server is on, then try again.
